caption: The drawing features a rectangular object that appears to be an envelope or card with its flap slightly open, shown against a plain, cream-colored background. The front surface of the envelope is decorated with a pattern on a bright blue background, featuring two yellow-brown birds, several leafy branches with pink flowers, and a yellow butterfly near the top center. The blue section is bordered by a pink edge. Behind the main blue section, a part of the inner lining or back of the envelope is visible, displaying a geometric design in blue and pink. Near the bottom right of the envelope, the artist's name, "TR. IBURER," is printed in small blue capital letters. The drawing is simple in composition, with the decorated envelope situated in the center and ample blank space surrounding it.
title: Needle Case
